competitor_evidence.text: Infineon focuses its sales efforts on semiconductors customized to meet customer needs.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We focus our sales efforts on semiconductors customized to meet our customers’ needs.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon seeks to design its products and solutions in cooperation with its customers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We therefore seek to design our products and solutions in cooperation with our customers so as to become their preferred supplier.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon aims to create relationships with major customers that are leaders in their market segments.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We also seek to create relationships with our major customers that are leaders in their market segments and have the most demanding technological requirements in order to obtain the system expertise necessary to compete in the semiconductor markets.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon believes that cooperation with leading customers provides special insight into their concerns and market development.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We believe that cooperation with customers that are leaders in their respective fields provides us with a special insight into these customers’ concerns and future development of the market.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon offers a broad portfolio of technological capabilities and competitive services to support its customers.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We believe that a key element of our success is our ability to offer a broad portfolio of technological capabilities and competitive services to support our customers in providing innovative and competitive products to their customers and markets.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon seeks to leverage its IP in ASIC-based system solutions.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: With our broad and complementary IP portfolio, system integration skills, and manufacturing expertise, we seek to leverage our IP in ASIC-based system solutions.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon concentrates on customized designs for customers such as Siemens and Microsoft Corporation.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We concentrate on customized designs for customers such as Siemens and Microsoft Corporation.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon's automotive segment includes sales of microcontrollers, power devices, and sensors.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: In the Automotive segment, which includes sales of microcontrollers, power devices and sensors, our customer base includes most of the world’s major automotive suppliers.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon's largest customers in the automotive segment include Bosch and Continental.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our two largest customers in the 2009 fiscal year were Bosch and Continental.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon's industrial products are sold primarily in small volumes to customers served directly or through third-party distributors.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: The bulk of our sales of industrial products are made in small volumes to customers that are either served directly or through third-party distributors such as Arrow, Avnet and WPG Holdings.

competitor_evidence.text: Infineon's sales of industrial products vary by type, with devices for drive and power conversion applications sold primarily in Europe and the United States.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our sales of industrial products vary by type of product, with devices for drive and power conversion applications sold primarily in Europe and the United States.

competitor_evidence.text: The front-end process involves producing electronic circuits on raw silicon wafers through a series of patterning, etching, deposition and implantation processes.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: In the first step, the front-end process, electronic circuits are produced on raw silicon wafers through a series of patterning, etching, deposition and implantation processes.

evidence.text: We employ a hybrid manufacturing model where we manufacture semiconductors through a combination of wholly owned manufacturing facilities, a manufacturing facility operated jointly with another semiconductor company and third-party foundries and assembly and test subcontractors.
evidence.excerpt: We employ a hybrid manufacturing model where we manufacture semiconductors through a combination of wholly owned manufacturing facilities, a manufacturing facility operated jointly with another semiconductor company and third-party foundries and assembly and test subcontractors.

evidence.text: The manufacturing of a semiconductor involves several phases of production, which can be broadly divided into 'front-end' and 'back-end' processes.
evidence.excerpt: The manufacturing of a semiconductor involves several phases of production, which can be broadly divided into 'front-end' and 'back-end' processes.

evidence.text: The front-end production cycle requires high levels of precision and involves as many as 300 process steps.
evidence.excerpt: The front-end production cycle requires high levels of precision and involves as many as 300 process steps.

evidence.text: Back-end processes involve the assembly, test and packaging of semiconductors in a form suitable for distribution.
evidence.excerpt: Back-end processes involve the assembly, test and packaging of semiconductors in a form suitable for distribution.

evidence.text: In contrast to the highly complex front-end process, back-end processing is generally less complicated, and as a result we tend to determine the location of our back-end facilities based more on cost factors than on technical considerations.
evidence.excerpt: In contrast to the highly complex front-end process, back-end processing is generally less complicated, and as a result we tend to determine the location of our back-end facilities based more on cost factors than on technical considerations.

evidence.text: We primarily focus our internal and joint venture wafer manufacturing operations on running proprietary specialty process technologies that enable us to differentiate our products on key performance features.
evidence.excerpt: We primarily focus our internal and joint venture wafer manufacturing operations on running proprietary specialty process technologies that enable us to differentiate our products on key performance features.

evidence.text: Our front-end manufacturing facilities use a broad range of production processes and proprietary design methods, including complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS), bipolar, bipolar CMOS (BiCMOS) and double-diffused metal on silicon oxide semiconductor (DMOS) technologies.
evidence.excerpt: Our front-end manufacturing facilities use a broad range of production processes and proprietary design methods, including complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS), bipolar, bipolar CMOS (BiCMOS) and double-diffused metal on silicon oxide semiconductor (DMOS) technologies.

evidence.text: Our wafer fabs produce semiconductors with line widths ranging from 90 nanometers to 3 microns for integrated circuits and 0.5 microns to greater than 4 microns for discretes.
evidence.excerpt: Our wafer fabs produce semiconductors with line widths ranging from 90 nanometers to 3 microns for integrated circuits and 0.5 microns to greater than 4 microns for discretes.

evidence.text: This broad technology portfolio enables us to meet increasing demand from customers for system solutions, which require a variety of technologies.
evidence.excerpt: This broad technology portfolio enables us to meet increasing demand from customers for system solutions, which require a variety of technologies.

evidence.text: As part of executing our hybrid manufacturing model, we have initiated the consolidation of our internal wafer fabs to 300 millimeter factories.
evidence.excerpt: As part of executing our hybrid manufacturing model, we have initiated the consolidation of our internal wafer fabs to 300 millimeter factories.
